data.title: Test Audit and PRISM-Causal Integration
data.summary: Comprehensive session covering test audit findings, PRISM-Causal integration planning, GoT SOP establishment, and test health restoration sprint setup.

sections.Test Audit Findings:
Comprehensive audit of test suite found 169 hidden tests that were not being collected by pytest. Root cause: Story-driven class names (e.g., DeveloperSearchesCorpus) lacked the required 'Test' prefix for pytest collection.

Fixed across 15 files:
- test_agent_spawning_stories.py (4 classes, 14 tests)
- test_cognitive_loop_stories.py (3 classes, 14 tests)  
- test_workflow_orchestration_stories.py (4 classes, 12 tests)
- test_pubsub_messaging_stories.py (5 classes, 15 tests)
- test_distributed_graph_stories.py (5 classes, 13 tests)
- test_woven_mind_stories.py (2 classes, 11 tests)
- test_thought_graph_stories.py (3 classes, 12 tests)
- test_developer_* files (various)
- test_prism_got_stories.py (4 classes, 17 tests)

The fix revealed ~27 pre-existing test failures that had been hidden.
